claim: The Achelse Kluis brasserie is closed Mondays year-round; summer (Apr 1–Nov 30) opens Tue–Thu 10:00–20:00, Fri–Sat 10:00–22:00, Sun 10:00–22:00; kitchen closes one hour before closing.
quote: Summer (April 1 - November 30): Monday: Closed; Tuesday-Thursday: 10AM–8PM; Friday-Saturday: 10AM–10PM; Sunday: 10AM–10PM. The kitchen closes one hour before closing time.

claim: The 5° Bruin and Blond Achel beers are only available on draft at the cafeteria/brasserie, while the bottled product is the 8°.
quote: 5° Bruin and Blond beers (5% ABV) can only be tasted here on draft in the cafeteria, while the normal product in bottles is the 8° which is 8% ABV

claim: Achel lost the Trappist designation in January 2021 after its last two monks moved to Westmalle; the abbey and brewery were later bought by Belgian entrepreneur Jan Torman and beer continues to be produced but can no longer be sold as Trappist.
quote: In 2021 the monastery closed, with the last two remaining monks moving to Westmalle Abbey... Following closure, the abbey buildings and brewery were bought by Belgian entrepreneur Jan Torman. Beer continues to be produced, but can no longer be sold as Trappist

claim: The Bocholter Brouwerijmuseum, billed as Europe's largest brewery museum, occupies a 4,000 m² complex opposite the Martens brewery fermentation tanks and ends in a tasting room.
quote: Bocholter Brouwerij Museum is Europe's largest brewery museum... a multifunctional museum of 4.000 m²... pass by the transport department and into the tasting room

claim: Standard adult admission to the Bocholter Brouwerijmuseum is €10.00.
quote: Wondering what a ticket to Bocholter Brouwerij Museum - Brouwerij Martens costs? These are the prices: €10.00

claim: In the Gault&Millau 2026 guide for North Limburg, Cuchara leads at 17.5/20, while Lommel's Cocotte (Jan Mangelschots) was upgraded to 14.5/20, and Hamont-Achel's Food Emotions reached 14.5/20 with newcomer Stad10 at 14.
quote: Cuchara, a restaurant run by chef Jan Tournier in Lepelstraat, is the best restaurant in North Limburg with a score of 17.5/20. Restaurant Cocotte... received an upgrade to a score of 14.5/20... Food Emotions received an upgrade to 14.5/20, and Stad10 is a new entry with 14 points.

claim: Restaurant Cocotte, Koning Leopoldlaan 94 in Lommel, is led by chef Jan Mangelschots and serves Belgian-French modern cuisine.
quote: Chef: Jan Mangelschots; Cuisine Types: Belgian, French, and Modern; Address: Koning Leopoldlaan 94, 3920 Lommel, Belgium

claim: Stad10 in Hamont-Achel is run by chef Bert Brouwers, offering refined French-based cuisine with Japanese and acidic accents.
quote: Chef Bert Brouwers presents refined cuisine with a French foundation and international influences... Japanese and fresh acidic flavours frequently appear on the menu

claim: Food Emotions sits at Bosstraat 160 in Hamont-Achel, is run by chef Mark Bonneu, holds 14.5 Gault&Millau points and is combined with a gastronomic shop.
quote: Food Emotions is located at Bosstraat 160 in Hamont-Achel... run by chef Mark Bonneu and is combined with a gastronomic shop... Gault&Millau rating of 14.5/20

claim: Lommel's weekly market is held every Wednesday 13:30–17:30 on and around the Hertog Janplein, right next to Cuchara.
quote: The weekly market takes place every Wednesday from 13:30 to 17:30 on and around the Hertog Janplein

claim: The Hertog Jan Brouwerij in Arcen (NL) offers a standard one-hour brewery tour at €19,95 p.p., a Bockbier Tour at €24,95 and an exclusive Liefhebbers Tour at €54,95; reservation recommended.
quote: De reguliere rondleiding door de Hertog Jan Brouwerij kost €19,95 per persoon voor volwassenen vanaf 18 jaar. De Bockbier Rondleiding... voor €24,95 per persoon... De Liefhebbers Tour... voor €54,95

claim: White asparagus ("white gold") is harvested across Dutch/Belgian Limburg from mid-April through 24 June, making late-May the peak season for farm-shop and restaurant menus near Lommel.
quote: Asparagus the White Gold... harvesting of Limburgse asperges during April, May, and June

claim: De Achelse Kluis sits on the Belgian-Dutch border at the gates of Nature Park De Groote Heide, combining the abbey shop, brasserie and walking routes in one stop.
quote: De Achelse Kluis: a hidden abbey treasure at the gates of Nature Park De Groote Heide
